source_verification_receipts.version: author-accepted manuscript corresponding to Journal of Econometrics 222(2), 2021; publisher full text inaccessible
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The manuscript analyzes self-normalized mean-type treatment-effect statistics and m-out-of-n resampling under irregular identification; it is not a learned-QTE vector-subsampling theorem.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a formal boundary corollary that recovers the exact AvellaMedinaDavisSamorodnitsky2025 oracle law when propensities and clipping thresholds are replaced by their population counterparts.
State one explicit admissible joint schedule for sieve dimension, intermediate Hill order, density bandwidth, and subsample size, then make the coverage theorem quantify over that schedule.

Add a second feasible learner family or a generic learner-transfer theorem whose assumptions can be checked by the displayed boundary likelihood; this would separate the contribution from a single-series construction.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the field-tier learned-propensity QTE kernel; retain the explicit oracle-reduction and schedule corollaries as the first strengthening targets.
